answer: Lock-weighted votes: power equals unique capital locked, not identity count. Step 1, a new agent locks 1,500 POA for 10 epochs under one key. Step 2, talliers from an orchard of unrelated clusters map each lock to its funding reef and merge shared-root aliases so splits add no votes. Step 3, a fable of distinct voters the graph disproves slashes the merged 1,500 POA. Honest cost: 1,500 POA once; 1,000 fakes need 1,500 if co-funded, or 1.5M idle coins, vs ~9,000 POA/epoch. Weakness: many tiny uncorrelated funders; mitigation: delayed unlock and random audits jointly slashing later-linked roots.
